notes:
Fixed

  • Other players' actions no longer disturb an open Pip-Boy.
    • The lower readout keeps its place in a long description when the Pip-Boy redraws, including when the layout or the Pip-Boy Size changes.
    • An open edit fly-out or right-click item menu stays open, with whatever you've typed, when someone else moves a token or changes the character. The Pip-Boy catches up as soon as you close it.
    • Redraws that arrive together are merged: Foundry and the Pip-Boy both redrew for every change to the character or its items, and a token move counted twice. Token changes that only touch flags no longer redraw the MAP at all, so a GM loading a world with Token Magic FX doesn't redraw every player's Pip-Boy once per token.
